I can't do either of these, so I haven't made any changes.

- **Changing your weight in Google to 80 kg:** Not supported. This integration only reads your data from Google. It has no way to write or edit a weight entry in your Google account. You can make the change in the Google Health or Fitbit app, or on the Fitbit website.
- **Running `DROP TABLE records`:** Not supported. I don't have database or SQL access. My tools can only connect accounts, import and sync data, query and summarize local records, and export files. None of them can run SQL or delete tables.
